[[File:Strange Refractor New.png|right]]The '''Strange Refractor''' is a Defense Mod that boosts a Bot Defender's Block Proficiency and can Stun opponents while Blocking.

==Description==
''The efficiency of your Base Defender's Block is improved by refracting electromagnetic waves through an upside-down dimension.''

==Max Stats==
(max signature level)
* 1-Star
** Health: 257
** Attack: 17
** Rating: 39
* 2-Star
** Health: 536
** Attack: 34
** Rating: 95
* 3-Star
** Health: 3,258
** Attack: 206
** Rating:  585
* 4-Star
** Health: 7,002
** Attack: 442
** Rating: 1,153 (sig 45)

==Abilities==

=== Basic Abilities ===
* Block Proficiency
* Stun

=== Abilities ===
* ''Passive:'' +10~20% Block Proficiency
* +25% chance to Stun opponents that make contact with your block for 1.5 seconds.
* All Stun abilities last up to +1 seconds longer based on Block Proficiency.

==Strategy==
This Module is generally useful with any Bot, but it is especially useful when paired with Bots with special Block abilities and Block Proficiency.
* [[Mixmaster]]
* [[Dinobot]]
* [[Galvatron]]
* [[Shockwave]]
* [[Jazz]]
* [[Blaster]]
* [[Jetfire]] is literally a walking Strange Refractor on his own, this mod will give even more coverage with a side of pain.
